text:
Uruguay has been widely praised for its pivot to green energy – a shift which was led by its former Energy Secretary, Ramon Mendez Galain. 

Here he tells CGTN how that forward thinking has insulated his country against global macroeconomic forces – such as war-disrupted energy
translated_text:
乌拉圭因转向绿色能源而受到广泛赞誉 — — 这一转变由前能源部长拉蒙·门德斯·加兰 (Ramon Mendez Galain) 领导。 

在这里，他向 CGTN 讲述了这种前瞻性思维如何使他的国家免受全球宏观经济力量（例如战争破坏的能源）的影响。
